PICTURE THIS: Carnegie Mellon University had a digital identity crisis. Their main website was a patchwork quilt of legacy systems, each department doing its own thing, and updating anything required the patience of a saint and the technical skills of a wizard. Something had to give.

That's where Carnegie Higher Ed came in—and despite the name similarity being pure coincidence, they knew exactly who to call for the technical heavy lifting. They brought us (Knectar) on board as their Drupal development partner, with them handling the content strategy and design while we tackled the technology strategy and architecture. Together, we embarked on a mission to give CMU a digital makeover that would make Marie Kondo proud. We rebuilt their entire web presence on Drupal 10, creating a component library so intuitive that even the most technophobic professor could drag and drop their way to web glory. Think of it as LEGO blocks for websites—over 50 different pieces (hero banners, event feeds, faculty bios, you name it) that snap together beautifully.
The real magic? We kept CMU's existing services humming along—their search, their LiveWhale events calendar, their various forms and feeds—while giving everything a fresh, unified look. Now 20+ internal teams share one streamlined system instead of wrestling with a dozen different platforms. The result? A 40% reduction in training time, lightning-fast performance scores, and probably a lot fewer IT support tickets. Sometimes the best transformations are the ones that make complex things feel simple.

PICTURE THIS: You're running a major medical school with over 40 departments, each doing groundbreaking research and training the next generation of healers—but your digital presence looks like it was stitched together by someone who skipped anatomy class. Enter Transit Authority Figures with their strategic insights and Knectar with our Drupal expertise, ready to perform some digital surgery. We created what's essentially a unified medical campus online—one platform that could house all 40+ departments while letting each maintain their unique identity and specialized content. The breakthrough was in the integration magic: faculty profiles automatically pulled publication data from PubMed (because no professor wants to manually update their research list), Temple's calendar system fed events directly into department pages, and the search functionality worked like having a knowledgeable resident who could instantly point you to any faculty member, research program, or resource. We built secure authentication through Temple's LDAP system and created permission levels that let department editors manage their own content without accidentally breaking anything else.

The transformation was immediate and measurable: page creation time dropped by 60% because editors could use drag-and-drop components instead of calling IT, faculty directory searches increased by 45% (because people could actually find who they were looking for), and Temple's accessibility audit came back with zero major issues. Most importantly, LKSOM finally had a digital presence that matched the caliber of their medical education and research—unified, accessible, and designed to help rather than hinder the important work of training tomorrow's physicians.

submenu.label: Lanshin
submenu.pageSummary:
Background

Lanshin partnered with Knectar to launch Lanshin.com, a Shopify‑based e‑commerce site showcasing Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) tools, skincare, body care, internal wellness products, training courses, and treatments. The goal was to create a polished, mobile‑responsive storefront that empowers Lanshin's team to manage content, products, and navigation with minimal technical support.

Objectives

  • Streamlined Content Management: Enable non‑technical staff to update pages, homepage sections, products, and menus via Shopify's admin interface.
  • Robust Product Taxonomy & Filtering: Support multiple categories (TCM Tools, Skincare, Body, Eyes, Scalp & Hair, Internal Wellness, Sets, Featured, New, Best Sellers) and allow customers to filter product lists intuitively.
  • Enhanced Product Detail Experience: Present rich product information—"Full Description," "How to Use," and "Ingredients" tabs—managed via Shopify metafields.
  • Upsell & Cross‑sell Functionality: Automatically surface related products on each product detail page to increase average order value.

Key Challenges

Complex Category Structure

With over a dozen collection types and nested menus, Lanshin needed a navigation system that scales without overwhelming the CMS.

Custom Product Tabs

The standard Shopify product template lacked dedicated fields for "How to Use" and "Ingredients," requiring a reliable metafields implementation.

Admin Usability & Training

Ensuring staff could confidently manage everything—from URL redirects to Smart Search & Filter settings—without risking site breakages.

Technical Approach

  • Modular Homepage Sections: Leveraged Shopify's Sections & Blocks to create editable homepage tiles (e.g., Featured Sets, Courses, Treatments) that Lanshin can reorder or toggle off via the theme customizer.
  • Collection‑Driven Filters: Configured product collections and tied them to the Sidebar Menu, enabling customers to refine products by category, skin benefit, or tool type.
  • Metafields‑Backed Tabs: Added custom metafields on the Product edit screen for "How to Use" and "Ingredients," rendered as separate tabs on the product detail page.
  • Smart Search & Filter Integration: Installed and configured the Smart Search & Filter app to manage upsells and cross‑sells, with related products auto‑populated based on Lanshin's merchandising rules.
  • Comprehensive User Guide: Delivered a 13‑page Shopify User Guide covering logging in, managing users, redirects, WYSIWYG editing, menus, and more—ensuring Lanshin's team can self‑serve daily operations.

Technology Stack

  • Platform: Shopify, Liquid templating, responsive CSS/SASS
  • Apps & Plugins: Smart Search & Filter for related products; native Shopify Navigation, URL Redirects, and Metafields; built‑in WYSIWYG editor
  • Hosting & Deployment: Shopify's CDN and secure checkout, with preview links for theme QA and a streamlined publish workflow

Outcomes

  • Operational Efficiency: Lanshin staff now update products, collections, and site content 3× faster, with clear workflows for redirects and menu management.
  • Improved UX & Discovery: Customers benefit from intuitive filtering, clear product information via dedicated tabs, and personalized upsell recommendations, driving higher engagement and average order value.
  • Scalable Foundation: The modular theme and comprehensive documentation position Lanshin to launch new product lines, collections, and content categories with minimal developer intervention.

Ready to transform your e‑commerce experience?

That's where Knectar's hands-on approach to making led to creating what's essentially a hybrid sculpture practice—combining traditional hand tools with CNC precision to explore new forms and textures that would be impossible to achieve with either approach alone. We developed workflows that could translate digital designs into toolpaths for machine carving while preserving opportunities for hand finishing and artistic interpretation that give each piece its unique character and soul.

The magic was in discovering how technology could enhance rather than replace the fundamental human satisfaction of working with stone and other materials. CNC machines could rough out complex forms with precision that would take days to achieve by hand, but the final surfaces, textures, and details still required the artist's touch to bring the work to life. Each piece became a dialogue between digital precision and human intuition, between algorithmic efficiency and artistic sensibility.

The transformation opened up new sculptural possibilities while honoring the timeless appeal of working with your hands to create physical objects that occupy space and invite touch. Sometimes the best making happens when traditional craftsmanship meets modern tools—platforms that expand creative possibilities while preserving the essential human connection to materials and the satisfaction of bringing ideas into physical reality.

PICTURE THIS: You love your dog more than most humans, but you're tired of playing doorman every time they want to explore the backyard or come back inside—and the commercial pet doors either look terrible, don't fit your specific setup, or cost more than a small appliance. This dog door project was born from the simple recognition that sometimes the best solutions to everyday problems are the ones you design and build yourself.

That's where Knectar's practical making approach led to creating what's essentially a custom access solution—combining traditional woodworking skills with CNC precision to design and fabricate a dog door that could be perfectly sized for a specific pet, seamlessly integrated into existing architecture, and built to last decades rather than seasons. The project explored how thoughtful design and quality construction could turn a simple functional need into an opportunity for craftsmanship.

The magic was in discovering how many design decisions go into something as seemingly simple as a dog door: the right height and width for comfortable passage, the proper spring tension for easy opening but secure closing, weather sealing that actually works, mounting solutions that don't compromise structural integrity, and finishes that complement rather than clash with existing home design.

The transformation created a custom solution that solved a specific problem while honoring both function and aesthetics. Sometimes the best design projects are the smallest ones—solutions that make daily life just a little bit easier while demonstrating that good design, quality materials, and careful construction can elevate even the most humble functional objects into something worth taking pride in.
